title: 1유닛 장면 · 4
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Lily, Max, Pomi, Digby). Scene: Three new cheerful letter trees stand in a row in the garden, each with a wooden sign on its trunk showing one big letter: the first tree's sign reads 'A' with a red apple, a toy astronaut and a toy arrow hanging from its branches; the second tree's sign reads 'B' with a yellow toy bus, a red backpack and a tiny doll bed hanging; the third tree's sign reads 'C' with an orange cat, a blue cup and a striped candy hanging. Lily and Max stand in front of the trees, proudly pointing at them one after another; Pomi floats between them glowing with joy. In the foreground corner, a grumpy grey mole in a striped nightcap and round spectacles has just poked his head out of a dirt hole with one paw at his mouth, and the children glance down at him in surprise. The three letters A, B and C on the signs are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Characters: Lily is a cheerful 7-year-old East Asian girl with a straight black bob haircut and a small red hair clip, wearing a bright yellow hoodie, blue shorts and green rain boots. Max is a shy 7-year-old East Asian boy with short curly brown hair, a blue cap worn backwards, an orange t-shirt, dark blue pants, white sneakers and a small green backpack. Pomi is a round apple-green garden sprite the size of a melon, with one small sprout leaf on top of its head, big shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, tiny stubby arms and no legs (it hops and floats), softly glowing. Digby is a grumpy old grey mole with a red-and-white striped nightcap, round spectacles, big pink digging paws and a tiny pink nose.
